description:
Advances: ancora.review

Stage: L11 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Review, Ancora.Review.Html, Ancora.Markdown (earmark_parser AST to owned HTML transform; raw HTML escaped inert; render failure degrades to escaped source; [[id]] wikilinks), ports of review/{file_diff,spec_diff,findings_delta}.ex (findings delta = repo-state findings computed on both sides via BaseView and diffed; no store), Prism.js carried with license header and NOTICE entry, grammar set trimmed to elixir, erlang, diff, yaml, markdown, json, html, css, javascript. Master-detail chassis with Spec/Code/Decisions pivots; Code pivot grouped by derived set (watched interface / supporting changes / test changes); findings inline per subject; verdict chip and triage panel carried. mix spec.review (--base, --output default _build/spec_review.html, --open). Stdout meta line byte-compatible (CI greps it). Size budget: review/*.ex plus markdown.ex at most 5,000 lines total, no module over 2,500, enforced by a test; pre-named first cuts in order: supporting-changes hunks degrade to a file-link list, findings delta degrades to HEAD-side repo-state only. Chip and panel are not cuttable.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.review.views, code_pivot_grouping, findings_inline, findings_delta_without_store, markdown_transform, meta_line_shape, prism_carried, size_budget, output_flag
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.review.scenario.clean_diff_renders_green_chip, drift_card_in_watched_interface, growth_listed_under_test_changes, findings_delta_categories, raw_html_escaped, render_failure_degrades, meta_line_golden, prism_license_present, line_budget_test, output_path
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.check --base HEAD; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: the shared CI spec-check job renders the artifact and greps the meta line; proving tests are the golden-output tests
  - Fixture hygiene: fixtures are source and spec strings; no compiled fixtures
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each pivot, each delta category, escape and degrade paths)
- Call-site Integration: production caller is the CI spec-check job (artifact + sticky comment) and Manuel in PR review; proving tests are the golden-output tests pinning the meta line, the escape posture, and the chip on a clean diff.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/output* (read-only here)
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.{check,validate,prime,next,status,init,decision.new}.ex
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/review.ex, lib/ancora/review/**, lib/ancora/markdown.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.review.ex
- priv/spec_review_assets/**
- test/ancora/review*_test.exs, test/ancora/markdown_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_review_test.exs, test/ancora/static/review_budget_test.exs, test/support/**
- NOTICE
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no MDEx, no native markdown; no Coverage pivot, triangle diagram, or strength chrome
- no evidence store or persisted snapshot
- no change to the meta line shape

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base HEAD emits a verdict line
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
